name: @posthog/ml-mirror-image-scrub
description: replay_vision consumer worker that scrubs inlined session-replay images for the ML-training mirror and writes them to S3. Stage 1 ships a lean sharp-only blur; the heavy native ML scrub (NSFW gate + face mosaic + text solid-fill) and its self-verifying eval harness are dev-only until Stage 2 promotes them. Standalone package (not registered in pnpm-workspace.yaml) so its deps never reach the root lockfile or the main plugin-server image.
